card.name: WHIMS acronym in estrogen labels
card.fires_on: The piece "IMS" that finishes the acronym WHIMS, written as (WHIMS) right after "Women's Health Initiative Memory Study" in hormone therapy labels.

modes.label: WHIMS acronym ending
modes.description: The closing part of WHIMS inside parentheses after the study's full name.
modes.example: The Women's Health Initiative Memory Study (WH<<IMS>>), a substudy of WHI,

card.plain: It fires on the end of the abbreviation WHIMS, the memory study of the Women's Health Initiative, in estrogen label text.
